name: P-006 current-source installed v1/v2 warm and fresh Codex carry
command: Inside the disposable host: install attested v1, bootstrap selected Codex, run a model turn, install v2, repair the generated home, enable IDEATE, resume the same model thread, render buildCarryDoc, enable AUTO after the stamp, and start a fresh Codex context with the carry document
summary: An isolated current-source operator and migrated PostgreSQL kept an installed v1 identity definition pinned after a real v2 update. A warm Codex resume used v1 and current IDEATE. The actual carry builder then stamped IDEATE; AUTO was enabled afterward, and a distinct fresh Codex context received a generation-mismatch full resync and replied with the v1 definition plus AUTO and IDEATE. The verifier completed teardown with exit 0.
